name: BJ's Wholesale Club Holdings, Inc.
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow moat: the membership model is proven and durable (record 8.5M members, membership fee income +9.9% in Q2 FY27, higher-tier penetration at a record 43%, 18 straight quarters of traffic growth), and ROIC proxy has stayed well above the cost of capital for five years (35.1% in FY2021 fading to 22.8% in FY2026, fundamentals.json) on a stable ~18-19% gross margin — but BJ's is the subscale #3 warehouse club (267 clubs, East-Coast concentrated) against Costco and Sam's Club/Walmart, switching costs are only an annual membership fee, and the ROIC fade plus a 20bp merchandise-margin decline in Q2 on pricing investment show pricing power is defensive, not offensive. CAP 8.5 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025, 2026 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Dependable membership warehouse operator, narrow moat 5/10 with ROIC still above 20% — but at $102.95 the OE yield is only 2.3% and the weighted IRR is 5.7% (even super-bull is 8.8%); it clears 15% only near $25.
moat_for: Membership model: record 8.5M members, fee income +9.9% YoY in Q2 FY27, higher-tier mix at a record 43%
ROIC proxy above 20% for five straight years (22.8% FY2026) on a stable ~18.6% gross margin
East-Coast club density plus 205+ gas stations driving frequent grocery-first trips; 18 consecutive quarters of traffic growth and 15 of share gains
Disciplined footprint growth: 25-30 new clubs every two years, new clubs from 2022-24 cohorts performing above chain average
moat_against: Subscale #3 player: 267 clubs vs Costco's ~900 and Sam's ~600 — weaker supplier leverage and brand reach
Near-zero switching costs — an annual membership fee is the only lock-in; members multi-home across clubs
ROIC proxy has faded every year (35.1% FY2021 to 22.8% FY2026) as growth capex rises; merchandise gross margin fell ~20bp in Q2 FY27 on pricing investment
Structurally thin ~3.8% operating margin leaves no buffer against a price war with Walmart/Costco
